t: You're in St Pancras Gardens, a public garden in London. Mary Wollstonecraft was buried here in 1797. She was an English writer and philosopher, best known for arguing for women's rights, and she is regarded as one of the founding feminist philosophers. Feminists often cite both her life and her works as important influences. Her life included several unconventional personal relationships, which for a long time received more attention than her writing did.
